source: ComicsBox USA series pages and their first Italian publication links
rules: Only canonical origins, regular titles, annuals, core miniseries and story-bearing crossovers are included.
Every mapped card uses the first Italian publication exposed by ComicsBox.
The same Italian album URL always resolves to the same global physical ID.
Missing Italian links remain declared gaps and never become synthetic owned issues.
Cosmic Ghost Rider is the final generated path.
